updates.body: We are currently investigating an issue where Bot Management configuration updates are not propagating to the edge. Our engineering team is aware of the issue and is actively working on a resolution. The running Bot Configuration at the Edge is not impacted. We will provide further updates as soon as we have more information.
We have identified and applied an effective fix for this issue. This incident is now resolved.

components.description: Bot Management provides sophisticated bot protection for your domain. Customers can identify automated traffic, take appropriate action, and view detailed analytics within the dashboard. Bot Management also supports custom solutions via Workers and Logs.
